0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-3, 6th in the East, 1st in the Southeast) visit the Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 7th in the East, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with the Wizards riding a two-game winning streak and a 2-2 road record. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 126-96 Hawks win in Atlanta on February 26, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series in which the Wizards lost 1-3.
